name: spotipw
spotifyglass_refresh: dylibs/spotifyglass.dylib is the clean Theos build of the migrated PwEevee product source tree at public version 3.1.5 (builder tree /Users/xcode/pweevee-3.1.5-src, `rm -rf .theos && make TARGET_CODESIGN=codesign TARGET_CODESIGN_FLAGS='--force --sign -'` because that builder has no ldid). Theos ad-hoc codesigns it (codesign --verify: valid on disk, flags=0x2), and it links @rpath/CydiaSubstrate.framework/CydiaSubstrate (rootless, required for sideloaded installs). This build only bumps the version string and replaces the packaged source; 3.1.0's pin was 45242a9f. origin/origin_sha256 still describe the deb this component was first extracted from
source_tree: taurus-rc/source (migrated PwEevee product source; public version in taurus-rc/source/public-version.txt, internal upstream line in taurus-rc/source/version.txt)

implementation_guard.$comment: Strings that must (required) / must not (forbidden) appear in the pinned spotifyglass.dylib, so an old-lineage or stale artifact can never be packaged silently. unified.sh hard-fails on a mismatch before merging; dylib-guard-test.pl verifies the same spec. The legacy update key spotifyglass.update.taurus.latest is REQUIRED: it is the pinned migration alias that lets pre-rename installs move their cached release across.
